sheet.layout: Row 1: portrait_bust, front_idle, back, side_left, side_right | Row 2: walk_front, walk_front_2, walk_back, prone_dead

mirror_note: Poses marked mirror_of can be derived by flipping the referenced pose horizontally. In-engine, generate SE/NW walk frames by mirroring the existing side walk if not explicitly drawn.

frames.label: Portrait Bust
frames.description: Close-up head and shoulders, 3/4 angle facing slightly left. Used for dialogue/menu portraits.
frames.notes: Larger cell than body sprites. Not a game-world sprite — UI only.

frames.label: Front Idle
frames.description: Full body, isometric 3/4 front-left angle, neutral standing pose.
frames.notes: Primary facing direction. Use as base for SW-facing animations.

frames.label: Back / Idle Back
frames.description: Full body, isometric 3/4 back-right angle, facing away from viewer.
frames.notes: NE-facing idle. Pair with walk_back for NE movement.

frames.label: Side Left
frames.description: Full body, pure left-facing side profile.
frames.notes: NW-facing idle. Mirror horizontally to get SE-facing (side_right equivalent).

frames.label: Side Right
frames.description: Full body, pure right-facing side profile.
frames.notes: SE-facing idle. This is effectively a horizontal mirror of side_left.

frames.label: Walk Front
frames.description: Full body mid-stride walking toward viewer, isometric front-left angle.
frames.notes: SW walk frame 1. Pair with walk_front_2 for a 2-frame walk cycle.

frames.label: Walk Front 2
frames.description: Walking toward viewer, opposite arm/leg swing variant.
frames.notes: SW walk frame 2. Alternate with walk_front for walk animation.

frames.label: Walk Back
frames.description: Full body back-facing mid-stride, walking away from viewer.
frames.notes: NE walk frame. Mirror horizontally for a second NE walk frame if needed.

frames.label: Prone / Dead
frames.description: Full body lying flat on the ground, arms at sides.
